summary: Fresh independent whole-chapter audit after the canonical Xiang curation: all 151 Chinese units, 423 temporal and active-hint items, and 204 person summaries were checked. The current Xiang record correctly removes the former reversed BC/AD interval and retains an unresolved source-based hold. Unit s0034 identifies Xiang as Shang’s younger brother and Fanyang branch founder but supplies no personal date or defensible chronological bound. The full report is therefore research-blocked rather than approved; no date is invented to close the hold.
